question: Given everything we've explored today, where should the ecosystem put its energy over the next 12 months?

items.title: A shared health-and-culture evidence framework that measures public value across sectors, not just outputs within each silo
Advocate to Treasury to embed wellbeing and prevention in decisions and institutions, with accountability for progress
Support and training for artists/arts sector to enable health outcomes safely
Longer funding cycles for community and arts organisations
Place-based local coordination roles and referral infrastructure connecting health and community assets
A dedicated cross-portfolio funding pool for health-generating infrastructure
Improve mechanisms that enable government departments to work together rather than in silos
Dedicated funding at local, state and commonwealth levels building capacity in community organisations to create health outcomes
Targeted investment in communities with the fewest existing assets
Documentation of leading Australian examples of combined arts-and-health approaches
Funded demonstration sites at genuine scale
